meta.description: Paste a job post, upload your CV, and find out how well you actually fit before you apply. Then rehearse the interview out loud.

footer.label: Footer
footer.about: A CV self-assessment and interview practice tool for job seekers, with an AI interviewer.

locale.label: Language
locale.accountBody: The language of the interface, and of your analyses and interview feedback. Quotes from your CV, lines of the posting and suggested bullets stay as written.

verdictRule.weak: A required item is missing, or two or more are only partly met.
verdictRule.fair: You meet the required items (one may be partly met) and fewer than two preferred ones.
verdictRule.strong: The same, with two or more preferred; a partly met one counts as half.
verdictRule.notShown: Whatever a CV can't show stays out of the count.

translation.pending: Translating. It takes a few seconds, and only happens once.
translation.partial: Some parts couldn't be translated and are shown in the original.
